Desk block built by renda-harness: one judge run for 3 pull requests instead of 3 (Drake 2026-10-20: do the shared work once, in blocks).

When this merges, each carried PR is closed with a link here. If the judge fails, the block is split and retried in halves; nothing is waived.

Carries #484 (train/encoder-r5@ce7fdce7): encoder R5: native SHFL.BFLY and F2FP.BF16 (patch step removed), f32 global atomic add
Carries #487 (train/tgemm-cut1@d0ffdd3c): tgemm cut 1: device-resident bf16 training GEMM (NN, f32 out) on the tensor cores
Carries #494 (fix/471-fp8-libm-free@f1c4be2f): gpu: libomega_gpu.a no longer references libm (FP8 packer ldexpf) (#471)
